glosses: to diss (to put someone down or show verbal disrespect)
wykonywać lub nagrywać utwór (zwykle hiphopowy) przeciwko komuś, wyśmiewający go lub obrażający
ogólniej: wyśmiewać, poniżać lub obrażać kogoś
To put (someone) down, or show disrespect by the use of insulting language or dismissive behaviour.

examples.text:
When a journalistic rival tries to "dis" you
And to prejudice you in the public's eyes.
Don't stigmatise his charges as a "tissue
Of palpable, unmitigated lies."

glosses: An insult or put-down; an expression of disrespect.

examples.text: I've been wondering what happens if I fail my diss. I know i'm allowed to fail 60 credits but I don't think that includes the diss.

glosses: Ampelodesmos mauritanicus syn. Ampelodesmos tenax, a reedy grass used for cordage.
